Draw diagrams with your AI — right on your machine.

A local, zero-dependency Draw.io MCP server in Go. Plug it into any MCP-compatible AI client and let your assistant create, edit, and export diagrams — all over stdio, no cloud required.

Get started in minutes

Three steps from download to first diagram.

1

Download the binary

Grab the build for your platform from the Releases page, or build from source with go build -o draw-io-gomcp ./cmd/server.

2

Register in your MCP client

Add the server to your client's MCP config file. The exact location varies — here's the shape:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "draw-io": {
      "command": "/absolute/path/to/draw-io-gomcp",
      "args": []
    }
  }
}
3

Start a session & draw

Trust the server in your client, start a new conversation, and ask: "Draw a sequence diagram of a login flow."

14 MCP tools, fully typed

Every tool ships with clear "when to use" / "when not to use" hints, error codes, and tier annotations.

start_session Open the live browser preview write
get_guide Load only needed drawing sections read
get_drawing_guide Legacy full-text guide read
get_shape_library List vendor shape libraries read
create_new_diagram Replace document from XML destructive
load_diagram Open .drawio file from disk destructive
edit_diagram Add / update / delete cells write
get_diagram Read current diagram XML read
screenshot_diagram Render diagram to PNG read
export_diagram Save as .drawio / .png / .svg write
list_pages List all pages in document read
add_page Append new tab write
rename_page Rename existing tab write
delete_page Remove tab (keeps 1) destructive
